source.exploreUrl:
<js>
let formatUrl = (url, category_index, order, time_type) => {
  return `{{ URL("/bookcity/${url}", {
"category_index": "${category_index}",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"order": "${order}",
"time_type": "${time_type}"
}) }}`
}

let push = (title, url, basis) => {
  list.push({
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
      layout_flexGrow: 1,
      layout_flexBasisPercent: basis
    }
  });
};
let list = [];
let order_list = {
  "fans_value": "畅销",
  "no_vip_click": "点击",
  "yp": "月票",
  "word_count": "更新",
  //"track_read": "追读",
  "complet": "完结",
  "blade": "催更",
  "yp_new": "新书",
  "recommend": "推荐",
  //"tsukkomi": "吐槽",
  "favor": "收藏"
};
let time_type_list = {
  "total": "总榜",
  "month": "月榜",
  "week": "周榜"
};

let url = URL("/bookcity/get_category_list");
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let category_list = response.category_list;
let tag_list = response.tag_list;

for (let timeTypeKey in time_type_list) {
  push(`【 ${time_type_list[timeTypeKey]} 】`, "", 1);
  for (let orderKey in order_list) {
    push(order_list[orderKey], formatUrl("get_rank_book_list", 0, orderKey, timeTypeKey), 0.29);
  }
}
push(`【 分类 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of category_list) {
  let category_index = item.category_index;
  let category_name = item.category_name;
  push(category_name, formatUrl("get_filter_search_book_list", category_index, "", ""), 0.29);
}

push(`【 标签 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of tag_list) {
  let tag_module = item.tag_module;
  let tag_name = item.tag_name;
  push(`${tag_name}`, `{{ URL("/bookcity/get_filter_search_book_list", {
"category_index": "0",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"${tag_module ? 'tag_module' : 'tag'}": "${tag_module ? tag_module : tag_name}",
}) }}`, 0.29);
}

JSON.stringify(list);
</js>

<js> 
//注意：一般网站默认首页(即baseUrl)有搜索框，否则请填入搜索页面地址
var url = baseUrl;
if (!baseUrl.match(/^https?:/i)) {
    java.log('\n\n\n\n‼️请填入正确的Url‼️\n\n\n\n');
}
var html = java.ajax(url + ",{'webView': true}");
//java.log(html);
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
//java.log(form);
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);
//java.log(charset);
//桌面版UA
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36";
//手机版UA
var uam = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 7.0; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/48.0.2564.116 Mobile Safari/537.36 T7/10.3 SearchCraft/2.6.2 (baiduboxapp; P1 7.0)";
var headers = {
    //请自行选择UA，↓↓↓填入此处
    "User-Agent" : uaw, "Referer" : String(baseUrl)
};
url = baseUrl.replace(/([^\/])$/i, '$1/') + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
//java.log(sk);
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);
